review:
The Irish party carries on. Wilds land on reels 2 to 4 with 2x, 3x or 5x multipliers that multiply each other when they share a win.

Six or more money symbols trigger the Money Respin: eight respins across four 3x5 grids where only money, super pots, bonus awards, multipliers or extra spins land. Super pots grow after each respin (up to 200x) and multipliers boost money values up to 25x. 96.55% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
